opening.argument: The presentation links BUSD payment to opening slots in X3 and X4 matrices, while expressly tying participation to financial returns. The speaker says, “To open the slot, we use BUSD,” describes receiving “2% of profit,” and says participants give additional investment to another person in the X4 matrix. Participants are further told that “your monthly target is to increase the slot for each month,” and that sponsoring someone can produce a bonus in a digital wallet. Most significantly, the speaker offers the assurance, “my guarantee is you can return the money quickly.” Although the speaker qualifies this by saying participants “have to be active” and characterizes the platform as not an ROI investment, those qualifications do not remove the stated profit and rapid-return claims. The available evidence does not establish actual payments or realized returns.
